settings.heading: What exactly is Soft Pauses?
settings.content: Soft Pauses is a proprietary, molecularly distilled compound consisting of high-purity Soft Pauses A and Trans-Resveratrol. It is engineered to bypass the limitations of the gut microbiome, ensuring that every cell receives the precise signaling required to initiate absorption and replenish hormonal density.

settings.heading: How soon will I notice the effects of Soft Pauses?
settings.content: While Soft Pauses begins tagging dysfunctional hormones within the first 8 hours of ingestion, the most significant physiological shifts occur after 30 to 60 days of consistent use. Clinical trials indicate that sustained daily energy and transdermal energy optimization are typically achieved by the 16-week mark.

settings.heading: Do I need to be on HRT for this to work?
settings.content: No, the biological process of absorption triggered by Soft Pauses occurs independently of physical exertion. However, we recommend a consistent movement practice, as the increased daily energy provided by the Soft Pauses variant is most effectively utilized when the hormonal system is under active demand.

settings.heading: Is there a "ramp-up period" required?
settings.content: There is no ramp-up period required for Soft Pauses. Our clinical protocol is based on a steady-state delivery of 500mg daily. Consistently taking two gummies at the same time each day ensures that your hormonal "recycling centers" remain active without interruption.
